title: Asiad: Jeus Yape shines in virtual taekwondo for PH's fourth gold
summary: Jeus Yape ruled the mixed individual virtual taekwondo event, Friday at the Toyohashi Gymnasium, after beating Vietnam's Chau Ngoc Tuyet Sang in the final.
